name: phpguard
description: Local-first PHP security checks for runtime versions, configuration, Composer advisories and risky source patterns.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: In an untrusted workspace, file-content checks still run, but php and Composer are never executed.

commands.title: PHP Security Guard: Show Last Report

viewsWelcome.contents:
No findings yet.
[Scan workspace](command:phpSecurityGuard.scanWorkspace)
Findings need manual review; this tool cannot certify a deployment as safe.

phpSecurityGuard.enableSourceHeuristics.description: Enable conservative line-based source checks. These are review candidates, not proof of a vulnerability.

phpSecurityGuard.runComposerAudit.markdownDescription: Run `composer audit` when Composer and a `composer.lock` are available. This contacts packagist.org and sends installed package names and versions; no source code is sent. Only runs in trusted workspaces.

phpSecurityGuard.maxFiles.description: Maximum number of matching files to analyse in one scan.

phpSecurityGuard.maxFileBytes.description: Files larger than this are skipped and reported, so a huge file cannot exhaust the extension host.

phpSecurityGuard.includeVendor.description: Also analyse the vendor directory. Dependency auditing is usually a better tool for vendor code.

phpSecurityGuard.phpPath.markdownDescription: Path to the `php` executable used for the version probe. Leave empty to use `php` from PATH. Only `php -v` is ever run; workspace files are never executed.

phpSecurityGuard.composerPath.description: Path to a Composer executable. On Windows a composer.bat shim cannot be launched without a shell, so prefer composerPharPath.

phpSecurityGuard.composerPharPath.description: Path to composer.phar, launched through PHP. Recommended on Windows when composer is installed as a .bat shim.
